First week of the month shouldn't be spent wrestling with spreadsheets.

Here is what usually happens across growing companies:
An ops lead downloads CSVs from Stripe, HubSpot, and Google Ads. They paste them into a master sheet, fix three broken VLOOKUPs, and email a static PDF to the leadership team. By the time anyone reads it, the numbers are already old.

When you connect those systems through simple workflow automations or lightweight internal dashboards, the friction disappears.

Your data syncs directly from the source. Metrics update automatically, and anomalies flag themselves before the monthly review even starts.

Software shouldn't just store information. It should bring your numbers together so your team can make decisions faster.
